convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for BlauErgodic indicator and relies on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for core smoothing and trade execution logic. Multi-smoothing chain with custom applied price enum makes conversion non-trivial.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup

other_exits: BuyPosClose/SellPosClose triggered by opposite signal in all three modes; close permission gates (BuyPosClose, SellPosClose inputs) control whether signal-based closes are executed

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: positive values = deposit fraction (share of deposit), negative values = fixed lot size. MMMode selects between LOT (fixed lot), FLOT (fractional lot), or other margin modes from MarginMode enum in TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Three distinct entry modes selected via AlgMode enum: 'breakdown' (histogram crosses zero), 'twist' (histogram direction change using 3-bar lookback), 'cloudtwist' (signal cloud color change via Up/Dn line crossover). Entry permission gates (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen) independently control long/short entries. Exit permission gates (BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) independently control signal-based closes. SignalBar parameter shifts signal evaluation back by N bars (default=1 means confirmed bar). Recount flag forces signal recalculation on CopyBuffer failure. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup. Trade execution delegated to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose from TradeAlgorithms.mqh which handle position management internally.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement BlauErgodic indicator from scratch - it uses 4-stage smoothing chain (momentum → EMA1 → EMA2 → EMA3 → signal EMA) via CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The SmoothAlgorithms library supports multiple smoothing methods (JJMA, VIDIA, AMA, etc.) via Smooth_Method enum; only MODE_EMA (1) is the default but all methods are available. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with margin calculation logic that must be replicated. The custom Applied_price_ enum (9 price types including TrendFollow) must also be reimplemented. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) - must confirm whether these need 10x adjustment for 5-digit brokers (no explicit adjustment in code, but TradeAlgorithms.mqh may handle it). Signal timing uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for next bar open assumption.
